chunks: A caravan happened to pass, and they sent its water-carrier, who let down his bucket. He said, 'O good fortune! Here is a boy.' And they hid him as merchandise; and Allah is Knowing of what they do.

key_terms.أَسَرُّوهُ: they hid him / took him as a captive
key_terms.سَيَّارَةٌ: a caravan or group of travelers

ai.seo_question: How was Prophet Joseph taken from the well to Egypt?
ai.summary: This verse marks the transition of Prophet Joseph (AS) from the well to the marketplace, where a caravan's water-drawer (*warid*) discovers him and identifies him as a precious commodity. In Shia exegesis, this event is often viewed as the first step in the divine plan (*tadbir ilahi*) that elevates him to power in Egypt, demonstrating how God's hidden wisdom orchestrates human actions for a greater purpose.
